blurb:
The Bender family continues a 50 year tradition of traveling in open air style safari vehicles north of Corolla along the ocean and sand dunes on a 2 hour, small group, excursion sharing history and ecology along the way. We stop for several photo opportunities and points of interests along the way, as well including private access to the Wild Horse Conservation Area. This tour also includes a professional and knowledgeable horse guide to educate you on what you are seeing. Choose from one of 3 departure times when you book.

The maximum will be TWELVE (12) people.

If you have more than 12 people please call us directly for accommodations. 

We will NOT be able to allow any children UNDER 45 POUNDS on the tour.
